campaigns.headline: Interested in a D&D Night at Whistle Stop?
campaigns.description: We're gauging interest before we schedule a recurring tabletop night on the patio. Tell us if you'd play, DM, or bring friends — no commitment until we hit our signup goal.
campaigns.socialDraft: 🎲 Thinking about hosting Dungeons & Dragons at Whistle Stop in Safety Harbor — patio, cold drinks, good company. Interested? Scan the QR or sign up — we'll only schedule it if enough players raise their hand.
campaigns.emailSubject: D&D at Whistle Stop? — quick interest check
campaigns.emailBody:
Hi {{name}},

Whistle Stop Grill & Bar on Main Street in Safety Harbor is exploring a Dungeons & Dragons game night — but only if enough locals are interested first.

If you'd play or DM, take 30 seconds to join the interest list:
{{signup_link}}

No date is set yet. If we hit {{goal}} signups, we'll pick a night and announce it.

— Whistle Stop team
